dockerfile
# Use a standard Ubuntu base image suitable for CPU-based HPC workloads.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set this environment variable to prevent interactive prompts during package installation.
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, Git, OpenMPI, and certificates.
# OpenMPI is the MPI implementation used for this build.
# We clean up the apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    make \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# These settings help prevent common errors related to process binding,
# network interface selection (disabling InfiniBand which is not present),
# and shared memory mechanisms within containers.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=ssh
ENV OMPI_MCA_orte_default_hostfile=/dev/null
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_hwloc_base_binding_policy=none

# Set a working directory for the build process.
WORKDIR /build

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 (LLNL AMG) repository,
# compile the application, copy the executable to a system-wide PATH location,
# and then clean up the source code to keep the final image lean.
RUN git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg.git && \
    cd amg/test && \
    make && \
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /build/amg

# Reset the working directory to a neutral location.
WORKDIR /

# Provide a default command. Running the application with '-h' will display its help/usage info.
CMD ["amg", "-h"]

# Use a standard Ubuntu base image suitable for CPU-based HPC workloads.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set this environment variable to prevent interactive prompts during package installation.
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, Git, OpenMPI, and certificates.
# OpenMPI is the MPI implementation used for this build.
# We clean up the apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    make \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# These settings help prevent common errors related to process binding,
# network interface selection (disabling InfiniBand which is not present),
# and shared memory mechanisms within containers.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=ssh
ENV OMPI_MCA_orte_default_hostfile=/dev/null
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_hwloc_base_binding_policy=none

# Set a working directory for the build process.
WORKDIR /build

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 (LLNL AMG) repository.
# CORRECTION: Run 'make' from the repository root to build all required library
# dependencies before building the final test executable.
# Then, copy the executable from its location in 'test/' to a system-wide PATH,
# and clean up the source code to keep the final image lean.
RUN git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg.git && \
    cd amg && \
    make && \
    cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /build/amg

# Reset the working directory to a neutral location.
WORKDIR /

# Provide a default command. Running the application with '-h' will display its help/usage info.
CMD ["amg", "-h"]

flux-minicluster-manifest
# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to run the AMG benchmark on a single AWS CPU instance within Kubernetes.
# It is configured for a small-scale test run.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg-minicluster-aws-cpu
  # The Kubernetes namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run. This should match the number of processes requested by the application.
  tasks: 4

  # When set to false, the pods and services are not deleted after the job completes.
  # This is useful for debugging and inspecting logs.
  cleanup: false

  # Specifies the logging verbosity and behavior for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Strict mode ensures that any logging-related errors will cause the job to fail.
    strict: true

  # Defines the container(s) that will run as part of the MiniCluster.
  # For this job, we only need one container definition.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This container is a worker, not a launcher. The Flux Operator will inject the flux broker and run the command.
      launcher: false
      # The command to execute within the container.
      # The Flux Operator will automatically wrap this with 'flux run'.
      # -problem 2: Specifies the AMG benchmark problem type.
      # -n 4 4 4: Sets a small problem size (4x4x4 grid) for testing purposes.
      # -np 4: Specifies that 4 MPI processes should be used, matching the 'tasks' field above.
      command: AMG -problem 2 -n 4 4 4 -np 4

# This corrected MiniCluster manifest runs the AMG benchmark on a single AWS CPU instance.
# The primary fix is correcting the command from 'AMG' to 'amg' to match the case-sensitive executable name in the container.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg-minicluster-aws-cpu
  # The Kubernetes namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run. This should match the number of processes requested by the application.
  tasks: 4

  # When set to false, the pods and services are not deleted after the job completes.
  # This is useful for debugging and inspecting logs.
  cleanup: false

  # Specifies the logging verbosity and behavior for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Strict mode ensures that any logging-related errors will cause the job to fail.
    strict: true

  # Defines the container(s) that will run as part of the MiniCluster.
  # For this job, we only need one container definition.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This container is a worker, not a launcher. The Flux Operator will inject the flux broker and run the command.
      launcher: false
      # The command to execute within the container, corrected to use the lowercase 'amg'.
      # The Flux Operator will automatically wrap this with 'flux run'.
      # -problem 2: Specifies the AMG benchmark problem type.
      # -n 4 4 4: Sets a small problem size (4x4x4 grid) for testing purposes.
      # -np 4: Specifies that 4 MPI processes should be used, matching the 'tasks' field above.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4 -np 4

# This MiniCluster manifest has been corrected for YAML syntax errors.
# Stray double quotes were removed from keys in the nodeSelector and environment sections.
# The configuration is for a larger-scale AMG benchmark on a specific AWS ARM instance.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg-minicluster-aws-cpu
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster will run on a single large node.
  size: 1
  # The number of tasks is set to 48, matching the vCPU count of the target r7g.12xlarge instance.
  tasks: 48

  # Job cleanup is disabled to allow for post-run inspection of logs and artifacts.
  cleanup: false

  # Defines Flux-specific settings, including the target architecture.
  flux:
    # Specifies the target architecture is ARM for AWS Graviton processors.
    arch: arm
    # Uses an ARM-compatible image for the Flux view container.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging is set to quiet mode to reduce verbosity, as specified in the update.
  logging:
    quiet: true

  # Pod-level specifications for scheduling.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      # Corrected the node selector key to remove invalid trailing quotes.
      # This ensures the pod is scheduled on the correct ARM-based AWS instance type.
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r7g.12xlarge

  # Defines the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # The command runs a larger problem (60x60x60) with a 4x4x3 process grid, totaling 48 tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 60 60 60 -P 4 4 3
      # This container is a worker; the Flux Operator provides the launcher logic.
      launcher: false
      # Environment variables to control threading and MPI performance.
      environment:
        # Pin OpenMP threads to 1 to ensure one MPI rank per CPU core.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        # Corrected the environment variable key to remove invalid trailing quotes.
        # This tunes OpenMPI's shared-memory communication mechanism.
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma

# This MiniCluster manifest is corrected to resolve a previous OOMKilled failure.
# It switches to a memory-optimized instance (r7g.12xlarge) and adjusts the workload accordingly.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg-minicluster-aws-cpu
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster is configured to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Tasks are set to 48 to match the vCPU count of the new r7g.12xlarge instance, preventing oversubscription.
  tasks: 48

  # Job cleanup is disabled to allow for post-run inspection of logs and artifacts.
  cleanup: false

  # Defines Flux-specific settings, including the target architecture.
  flux:
    # The r7g instance type uses ARM architecture.
    arch: arm
    # An ARM-compatible image is specified for the Flux view container.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging is set to strict mode to ensure any logging issues are treated as fatal errors.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Pod-level specifications for scheduling.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      # The node selector targets the r7g.12xlarge instance, which provides more memory (384 GiB).
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r7g.12xlarge

  # Defines the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # The command is updated with a reduced problem size (128x128x128) to ensure it fits in memory.
      # The process grid (-P 8 6 1) is adjusted to match the new task count of 48.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 128 128 128 -P 8 6 1
      # This container is a worker; the Flux Operator provides the launcher logic.
      launcher: false
      # Environment variables to control threading and MPI performance.
      environment:
        # Pin OpenMP threads to 1 to ensure one MPI rank per CPU core.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        # This tunes OpenMPI's shared-memory communication mechanism.
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma

# This MiniCluster manifest is corrected to address a job failure caused by strict logging.
# Although the application pod completed successfully, non-fatal framework errors were
# treated as a job failure. The logging mode is changed from 'strict' to 'quiet' to resolve this.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg-minicluster-aws-cpu
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster is configured to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Tasks are set to 48 to match the vCPU count of the r7g.12xlarge instance.
  tasks: 48

  # Job cleanup is disabled to allow for post-run inspection of logs and artifacts.
  cleanup: false

  # Defines Flux-specific settings for the ARM architecture.
  flux:
    arch: arm
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging is set to quiet mode to prevent non-fatal framework errors from
  # incorrectly marking the entire job as failed.
  logging:
    quiet: true

  # Pod-level specifications for scheduling on a specific memory-optimized instance.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r7g.12xlarge

  # Defines the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # The command runs the AMG benchmark with a specific problem size and process grid.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 128 128 128 -P 8 6 1
      # This container is a worker; the Flux Operator provides the launcher logic.
      launcher: false
      # Environment variables for performance tuning.
      environment:
        # Pin OpenMP threads to 1 to ensure one MPI rank per CPU core.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
        # This tunes OpenMPI's shared-memory communication mechanism.
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma
